summary: fix(wework): restore Printing Press publish readiness
reason: The historical browser-sniff run was copied before promotion, so it lacked publish manifests and a machine-readable Phase 5 proof; its module checksums were incomplete, it targeted Go 1.26.5 after security fixes shipped in 1.26.6, the hand-authored cancel command silently emitted empty stdout for JSON dry runs, and the hand-authored auth import leaf collided with the generated top-level import command in skill verification.
validated_outcome: Printing Press quick live dogfood passed 18/18 authenticated checks on the headless VPS with destructive endpoints disabled; verify-skill and publish package pass; auth import remains a compatibility alias for the canonical session-import command; cancel dry-run JSON has a public CLI regression test; the account's WeWorkBookings array remained empty; Go 1.26.6 is declared, vulnerability-free on called code, and the module graph is tidy.
